regime_context: The detector shows Gold Miners as a clear, durable, high-breadth leader with no scorable ETF proxy, while the only other truly eligible trend is a narrowing rotation. Critically, gate_helps is false on this market — even the drawdown-control edge did not hold on China A-shares history — and the track record shows directional accuracy well below coin-flip (36.8%). This is a display-only, experimental state with zero validated forward edge; I am leaning low and will prefer subjects with scorable proxies.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Semiconductors (rank 4, ETF 512760.SS, eligible, hurst_tag trend) can build breadth beyond its current 0.0 — the observable condition to retire this watch is breadth rising above 0.5 on the next detector snapshot, which would confirm participation beyond a single large name.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals is the only theme in the top tier that is scorable (ETF 512400.SS), eligible, and shows a coherent trend (durability 0.72, breadth 0.846) without being crowded. It is the rotation challenger to Gold, and the strength is relatively broad-based rather than a single-name artifact. Given China's macro backdrop is dominated by geopolitics and energy headlines, industrial metals sits adjacent to both. I lean overweight as a conditional expression of the narrow eligible trend set, not as a detector-derived return forecast.
evidence: rotation.challenger is Industrial Metals with margin 0.803 behind Gold
theses.dissent: gate_helps is false on this market — the trend gate did not reduce drawdown here, so even the one validated edge does not apply. The theme's hurst_tag is 'mixed' not 'trend', and the cross-sectional momentum rank has rank-IC ~0, so there is no alpha signal. The CSI 300 benchmark may simply mean-revert against this lean.

falsifier.text: Industrial Metals ETF (512400.SS) underperforms the CSI 300 by 5% within the next 21 trading days

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO (ETF 159992.SZ) shows a crowding flag (crowding_z 1.15, crowded true) combined with weak durability (0.52) and narrow breadth (0.357). The crowding caution is a size-down signal, not a fade signal, so this is framed as an underweight rather than an avoid — and given the detector has no validated edge at all here, this is a humble, conditional lean against holding it at current prominence.
evidence: guardrails permit flagging crowding as a sizing caution only
theses.dissent: The crowding flag has NO basket-level forward edge (per backtest_verdict) and fading on crowding is the documented failure mode. Pharma & CXO could simply continue its relative trend regardless of the crowd; healthcare may be a defensive haven if geopolitics escalates.

falsifier.text: Innovative Pharma & CXO ETF (159992.SZ) outperforms the CSI 300 by 5% within the next 21 trading days

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal (ETF 515220.SS) sits in the eligible middle with full breadth (1.0) but a mean-revert hurst tag, indicating the recent strength may be unstable and prone to reversing. With energy as only a minor macro narrative (n=3) and gate_helps false on this market, the trend leg is weak. Lean underweight as a conditional expression of low durability despite the breadth.
theses.dissent: Breadth of 1.0 means every constituent is participating; coal dividends in China historically offer defensive value, and the mean-revert tag may simply reflect a healthy pullback in a longer uptrend.

falsifier.text: Coal ETF (515220.SS) outperforms the CSI 300 by 5% within the next 15 trading days
